verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows New Relic shipping its own MCP server so external AI tools can query New Relic data (new-relic-docs-11, -22, -35, new-relic-probe-3) — the reverse direction of the story, which asks whether New Relic itself can plug in and consume external MCP servers as tools. No evidence describes New Relic's AI assistant or agent consuming third-party MCP servers.
